project_metadata.name: vnstock
project_metadata.description: Continuous 24/7 Quantitative Research, Predictive Analytics & Simulation Engine for Vietnamese Financial Market

backend.architecture: Domain-Driven Design (DDD) with Clean Architecture layers (presentation, application, domain, infrastructure)

core_engines.engine_1: Technical & Price-Action Engine (1m/5m/15m OHLCV, intraday tick matching flow)
core_engines.engine_2: Liquidity, Flow & T+2 Cash Flow Engine (Foreign flow, proprietary flow, FX USD/VND, Gold, T+2 settlement model)
core_engines.engine_3: Quantitative ML & Basis Spread Engine (VN30F1M vs VN30 basis spread, Volatility forecasting, ForecastJournal audit)

backend.app/main.py: FastAPI application entrypoint, CORS middleware, lifespan events, openapi configuration
backend.app/utils.py: Utility functions for password reset emails and system helpers
backend.app/initial_data.py: Initial DB seeds and first superuser setup

app/api.deps.py: FastAPI dependency injection (get_db session, get_current_user, get_current_active_superuser)
app/api.main.py: API v1 router aggregator mapping domain routers
app/api.private_router.py: Protected administrative and internal management endpoints
app/api.system_router.py: System health check, versioning, and status routes

app/core.config.py: Pydantic Settings reading environment variables (.env, DB connection strings, SECRET_KEY)
app/core.db.py: SQLModel database engine, session local creation, init_db function
app/core.security.py: JWT access token creation, verification, and passlib password hashing context

app/cron.scheduler.py: APScheduler background cron job runner initialization
app/cron.sync_symbols.py: Cron entry for symbol universe synchronization
app/cron.sync_daily_market.py: Cron entry for daily OHLCV market data backfill
app/cron.sync_quarterly_financials.py: Cron entry for quarterly financial statements ingestion
app/cron.purge_ticks.py: Cron entry for tick data retention and old log pruning

app/cli.stock_sync.py: Command-line script for manual market sync triggers

app/domains/market_data.application/price_service.py: High-level service fetching OHLCV bars, tick history, real-time prices
app/domains/market_data.application/symbol_service.py: Service managing symbol listings, VN30 components, ICB industry groups
app/domains/market_data.application/sync_service.py: Orchestrates backfilling and incremental sync from vnstock adapters
app/domains/market_data.application/sync_constants.py: Sync interval definitions, backfill date limits, default symbols
app/domains/market_data.application/schemas.py: Pydantic request/response schemas for price queries and symbol lookup
app/domains/market_data.application/jobs/purge_ticks_job.py: Job logic for purging old tick data beyond retention window
app/domains/market_data.application/jobs/sync_daily_market_job.p: Job logic for daily historical price sync
app/domains/market_data.application/jobs/sync_symbols_job.py: Job logic for syncing full ticker catalog
app/domains/market_data.domain/asset_master.py: Domain logic for asset categorization (Equities, VN30F1M Futures, Indices)
app/domains/market_data.domain/models.py: SQLModel tables: StockOHLCVDaily, StockOHLCVIntraday, StockTick, StockSymbol
app/domains/market_data.domain/rate_limit.py: Domain definitions for API rate limiting policies
app/domains/market_data.domain/exceptions.py: Domain-specific exceptions for market data (SymbolNotFound, DataUnavailable)
app/domains/market_data.infrastructure/vnstock_adapter.py: Primary integration layer invoking python `vnstock` v4 libraries
app/domains/market_data.infrastructure/vnstock_registry.py: Registry managing active vnstock adapter instances
app/domains/market_data.infrastructure/tick_storage.py: Optimized tick storage and aggregation handlers
app/domains/market_data.infrastructure/rate_limiter.py: Token bucket / delay rate limiter preventing IP bans
app/domains/market_data.presentation/vnstock_router.py: Endpoints surfacing raw vnstock adapter diagnostic checks
app/domains/market_data.presentation/router.py: Aggregated router for market data domain

app/domains/fundamental.application/corporate_service.py: Service querying company profiles, shareholders, officers, subsidiaries
app/domains/fundamental.application/screener_service.py: Fundamental screener filtering stocks by ROE, ROIC, P/E, P/B, Debt/Equity
app/domains/fundamental.application/revision_service.py: Service tracking earnings revision and financial metric changes
app/domains/fundamental.application/schemas.py: DTOs for corporate profile, financial statements, valuation ratios
app/domains/fundamental.application/jobs/sync_quarterly_financia: Job ingesting income statement, balance sheet, cash flow
app/domains/fundamental.domain/exceptions.py: Domain exceptions for missing financial statements

app/domains/quant.application/forecast_journal_service.py: Service recording predictions, back-filling actuals, scoring MAE/accuracy
app/domains/quant.application/market_data_ingest.py: Ingests tick/OHLCV data into live quants feature buffers
app/domains/quant.application/quant_sync_service.py: Syncs quantitative feature stores and baseline indicators
app/domains/quant.application/engines/technical_engine.py: Engine 1: Multi-timeframe RSI, MACD, VWAP, Order Flow Buy/Sell Delta
app/domains/quant.application/engines/flow_engine.py: Engine 2: Foreign net flow, proprietary desks flow, USD/VND, Gold, T+2 flow
app/domains/quant.application/engines/quant_ml_engine.py: Engine 3: VN30F1M vs VN30 Basis spread, GARCH/HV Volatility, Probabilistic outcome
app/domains/quant.application/engines/ensemble_engine.py: Ensemble decision layer combining Engine 1 + Engine 2 + Engine 3
app/domains/quant.application/daemon/clock.py: Market session state clock (ATO, Continuous, Intermission, Pre-ATC, ATC, Post-Market)
app/domains/quant.application/daemon/dispatcher.py: Event dispatcher broadcasting signal triggers to subscribers
app/domains/quant.application/daemon/orchestrator.py: Main daemon loop managing 24/7 background tasks and real-time computation
app/domains/quant.application/daemon/poller.py: Poller checking live order book & intraday matching ticks
app/domains/quant.application/daemon/scheduled_hooks.py: Hook callbacks triggered at ATO/ATC transitions
app/domains/quant.application/daemon/state.py: In-memory state buffer holding active session features
app/domains/quant.application/daemon/symbol_registry.py: Monitored tickers registry for quant daemon
app/domains/quant.domain/indicators.py: Pure technical and statistical indicator calculation functions
app/domains/quant.domain/exceptions.py: Exceptions for forecast scoring or daemon state errors

app/domains/simulation.application/engine.py: Main simulation engine executing paper trade orders and updating paper portfolios
app/domains/simulation.application/order_matcher.py: Matches virtual limit/market orders against real intraday tick/OHLCV execution
app/domains/simulation.application/margin_calculator.py: Derivatives initial margin, maintenance margin, and leverage check
app/domains/simulation.application/t_plus_2_manager.py: Enforces Vietnamese stock T+2 settlement for paper share/cash balance
app/domains/simulation.application/alpha_screener.py: Filters high-alpha stock baskets for paper portfolio rebalancing
app/domains/simulation.domain/models.py: SQLModel tables: PaperPortfolio, PaperOrder, PaperPosition, SimulationSession
app/domains/simulation.domain/settlement.py: Domain logic for T+2 settlement schedule calculation

app/domains/identity.application/crud.py: CRUD database operations for User and Item entities
app/domains/identity.application/schemas.py: Schemas for UserCreate, UserUpdate, UserPublic, Token, ItemCreate
